result.description:
Metal City Roofing offers expert construction services for commercial buildings, warehouses, offices, and retail spaces across Adelaide and South Australia. Whether you’re planning a new build or expanding your current premises, we specialise in delivering functional, modern, and code-compliant buildings—all up to two-storey high.

We understand the unique needs of business and industry—every project is tailored to suit operational requirements, site conditions, and budget. Backed by years of experience and a skilled construction team, we deliver safe, efficient, and high-quality builds with a focus on longevity and compliance.

We are seeking experienced and qualified MECHANICAL TECHNICIANS to join our team of professionals. We are looking for reliable individuals with a strong commitment to positively contribute to the success of our organisation.

Your duties will include but are not limited to:
Conduct regular inspections and maintenance of machinery and equipment to ensure optimal operation
Prepare drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers
Conduct root cause analysis, fault-finding and diagnosing efficient solutions to machine breakdowns
Troubleshoot mechanical issues
Installs, removes, inspects and repairs mechanical spare parts like bearings, seals on typical mechanical equipment
Performs major overhaul of equipment with or without external contractors and vendors
Disassembles, assembles, observes, repairs, tests, collects data and prepares reports on equipment, as tasks related to maintenance
Maintaining non-electrical safety, process and utility equipment
Perform power plant rigging, and lifting equipment necessary for safely handling heavy machinery and materials
Optimise mechanical efficiency by adjusting machinery and equipment settings
Troubleshoot process equipment, automation issues that may arise at the manufacturing line
Ensuring that products meet compliance regulations
Carry out work instructions as given by Supervisor, work specifications, equipment operation
Supports improvement projects
Fabricates and repair metal products and parts by using machine shop tools and equipment
Controls downtime by performing routine preventative maintenance requirements, daily equipment inspections, and monitoring machine operational performance
Perform duties consistent with established safety rules and procedures
Installing and commissioning new equipment as directed
Communicating with and supporting engineers
Understand customer change request and provide schedule
Documenting machine safety and maintenance

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade Qualifications and +5 years proven relevant experience
Proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining mechanical equipment
Strong knowledge of troubleshooting technique and problem-solving skills
Extensive knowledge of mechanical engineering designs, installations, maintenance, and repairs
Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and diagrams
Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintenance tasks
Physically fit and able to work in various conditions
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you have the skills and experiences we need and have a positive attitude, please apply now.
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

result.description: Greenultimate Pty Ltd   The ICT Support Engineer  will be responsible for maintaining and supporting the organisation's IT systems and infrastructure to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. The role involves troubleshooting hardware, software and network issues, installing and maintaining computer systems, providing technical support to staff, monitoring system performance, and assisting with system improvements. The successful candidate will also maintain technical documentation, deliver user guidance, and work closely with internal teams to ensure reliable, secure and efficient ICT services.   Benefits   Competitive salary package.  Friendly and supportive team environment.  Opportunities for training and career progression.  Exposure to diverse ICT projects and technologies.  Stable full-time role with long-term career opportunities.    Task & responsibilities   Lead and drive IT systems and infrastructure efficiency in the organisation.  Conduct regular system reviews and quality audits to evaluate the performance, reliability and security of ICT systems.  Analyse system performance, identify risks, gaps or areas of non-compliance, and recommend practical solutions to improve efficiency and service quality.  Monitor ICT systems, processes and documentation to ensure compliance with company standards and operational procedures.  Investigate, evaluate and diagnose hardware, software, LAN, WAN, network and connectivity issues in company offices, and provide timely support with resolutions.  Install, configure, maintain, upgrade and troubleshoot computers, operating systems, software applications, printers, networks and cloud-based services.  Develop and deliver technical guidance and user training on software applications, business systems and ICT procedures.  Work closely with staff and management to promote awareness of ICT policies, security practices and quality standards.  Create, review and maintain technical documentation, including user guides, operating procedures, technical specifications and support records.  Provide technical expertise to support system maintenance, infrastructure improvements and the ongoing reliability of business systems.  Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues and improve system performance and customer service.    Qualification & experience      A relevant bachelor’s degree qualification is highly preferred  Minimum 2 years of work experience in a similar role  Excellent troubleshooting and Problem-solving skills  Strong Communication and time management abilities  Support team culture and work collaboratively with colleagues  Strong customer service skills with a proactive and professional approach. Vacancy Listing Dates 9/07/2026 to 6/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 16958
- Skilled Site Services Environmental Advisor wanted
- Full time opportunity - FIFO
- Join the team at Plus Pumps Australia

Plus Pumps offers expert dredging consulting equipment and services, as well as industrial pump sales and repair. Committed to excellence, Plus Pumps provides cutting-edge solutions for the construction, mining, dredging, dewatering, water treatment, and a variety of other heavy industrial sectors.

We are currently seeking a Site Services Environmental Advisor to join our team in a FIFO role. Our head office is based in Welshpool.

Applicants must have 2+ years' experience in a similar role and hold a relevant qualification.

Responsibilities:
- Assist Plus Pumps management with the tendering process for projects to ensure all environmental aspects are covered.
- Work with Plus Pumps client’s premobilisation for the environmental components of projects through mining and marine sectors.
- Monitor environmental performance during dredging and pump operations across mine sites and projects throughout Australia.
- Ensure monitoring tools are maintained and calibrated.
- Carry out daily environmental inspections on dredge units, pumps, pipelines, hose connections, bunding and spill areas.
- Report all environmental observations, monitoring data and incidents in written reports to the Plus Pumps Operations Manager and site environmental teams.
- Support pump setup and pipeline checks identifying environmental risks such as leaks, spills or sediment disturbance and ensure compliance with environmental limits and license conditions.
- Assist with risk assessments (JHAs/JSAs) and recommend environmental controls for dredging and pump maintenance.
- Assist Plus Pumps management with completion of projects to ensure all environmental compliance aspects are met.

A salary of $110,000 - $130,000 will be offered to the successful candidate.

Apply now through our online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/16958.php

Sponsorship may be available to the right person.

Job Position : System Analyst
Location: Parramatta NSW 2150
Company: Discount Building Material Pty Ltd
Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About Us
Discount Building Material Pty Ltd, located in Parramatta NSW 2150, is an Australian technology-driven building materials platform connecting leading manufacturers with a nationwide network of resellers. Through a single digital portal, the company streamlines wholesale ordering, delivers accurate product information, and enables seamless supplier integration to improve procurement efficiency across the building materials industry.

Key Duties
• Consult with business stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business and system requirements for ICT solutions.
• Review existing information systems, business processes, and workflows to identify
opportunities for improved functionality, efficiency, and performance.
• Prepare functional specifications, process models, workflow diagrams, and technical
documentation to support system development and implementation.
• Evaluate and recommend system enhancements and ICT solutions that align with business objectives and operational requirements.
• Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and external service providers throughout the design, development, and implementation of business systems.
• Coordinate system testing activities, validate business requirements, and ensure
implemented solutions satisfy functional and operational expectations.
• Monitor system performance, investigate system issues, and recommend continuous
improvements to optimise reliability and business outcomes.
• Develop user documentation, provide implementation support, and assist with user training to promote effective adoption of new and enhanced systems.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
• A minimum of one (1) year of relevant post-qualification experience in systems analysis, business analysis, information systems, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience in analysing business requirements, evaluating ICT systems, preparing functional specifications, and supporting the delivery of system solutions.
• Sound knowledge of systems analysis methodologies, business process modelling, systems integration, software development life cycle (SDLC), and system testing practices.
• Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.

What We Offer
• Competitive annual salary, based on qualifications and experience.
• Opportunity to work on innovative business systems and digital transformation projects.
• Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
• Supportive, collaborative, and technology-focused workplace.
• Stable employment opportunity with a growing Australian business.

How to Apply
If you are an experienced System Analyst with a passion for improving business systems and delivering effective solutions, we encourage you to apply.

Take Ownership of Modern DevSecOps Environments Across Secure and Mission-Critical Systems   Your new company     
 Our client is a leading organisation operating within a secure and technically complex environment and is seeking to engage a DevSecOps Engineer on a permanent basis. Working as part of a collaborative engineering team, you will contribute to the delivery and sustainment of modern software development platforms, automation capabilities and secure infrastructure that support critical business outcomes.   This role is based in Brisbane and requires a commitment to working onsite 4-5 days per week. Due to the nature of the environment, this position cannot be performed remotely. Brisbane-based candidates are strongly preferred, however applications are welcomed from interstate candidates who are genuinely committed to relocating. Joining a collaborative engineering team, you will contribute to the delivery and sustainment of modern software development platforms, automation capabilities and secure infrastructure supporting critical business outcomes.  An NV2 Security Clearance is highly desirable. We also encourage applications from candidates who hold NV1 or Baseline clearances, or Australian Citizens who are eligible and willing to obtain a security clearance. 
   Your new role     
 As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, implementation and ongoing support of secure software development environments and CI/CD pipelines. Working alongside engineering, infrastructure and security teams, you will help drive automation, improve platform performance and ensure development environments remain secure, scalable and compliant.   
  Key responsibilities:   
 
 Designing, implementing and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines 
 Supporting and optimising secure software development environments 
 Deploying, configuring and maintaining Kubernetes and Docker platforms 
 Developing and supporting GitLab CI/CD workflows and integrations 
 Managing Linux and Windows-based development environments 
 Building and maintaining Ansible automation and configuration management solutions 
 Troubleshooting platform, infrastructure and application issues 
 Producing and maintaining technical documentation and configuration records 
 Supporting ongoing platform maintenance, upgrades and continuous improvement activities 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful, you will bring proven experience within DevSecOps, platform engineering or infrastructure automation environments, along with a strong focus on security, reliability and operational excellence. 
   
  Key requirements:  
 
 CI/CD pipeline design, implementation and support 
 GitLab administration and pipeline development 
 Kubernetes and Docker environments 
 Ansible and Infrastructure as Code methodologies 
 Linux administration, particularly Ubuntu and Red Hat 
 Secure software development environments and DevSecOps practices 
 Technical troubleshooting and performance optimisation 
 Documentation, change management and governance processes 
 
  Highly desirable:  
 
 Defence, government or other highly regulated environments 
 Security governance and compliance frameworks 
 Certifications such as Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), RHCSA or similar 
 Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security or a related discipline 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Exposure to modern DevSecOps, automation and cloud-native technologies 
 The opportunity to work within a secure and technically advanced environment 
 A collaborative team culture that values innovation, continuous improvement and technical excellence 
 Long-term career development and professional growth opportunities 
 
  What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

East Brisbane Based | Defence Industry | Long-Term Contract Opportunity | Attractive Rates   
 An exciting opportunity exists for a Systems Engineer / Verification & Validation (V&V) Engineer to join a leading Defence organisation supporting the delivery of a major complex capability program. 
 Working as part of a highly skilled multidisciplinary engineering team, you will play a key role across the systems engineering lifecycle, helping define, verify and validate critical system requirements while ensuring successful integration and delivery outcomes. 
 This role would suit engineers with experience in Defence, aerospace, rail, maritime, automotive or other highly regulated environments who enjoy working at the intersection of requirements, testing, integration and system performance. 
   
  Key Responsibilities  
 
 Support the development, management and traceability of system requirements. 
 Conduct systems engineering activities across the full engineering lifecycle. 
 Develop Verification & Validation strategies, plans and procedures. 
 Define and execute verification activities including analysis, inspection, demonstration and test. 
 Support system integration, test readiness reviews and acceptance activities. 
 Work closely with software, hardware, mechanical and project engineering teams to ensure requirements are met. 
 Identify, investigate and resolve technical issues throughout the development lifecycle. 
 Contribute to requirements management, risk assessments and engineering documentation. 
 Support customer reviews, technical presentations and engineering governance activities. 
 
   What you'll need to succeed       
 
 Degree qualified in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline. 
 Experience working within Defence or other complex engineering environments. 
 Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and processes. 
 Experience developing or managing requirements using tools such as DOORS, DOORS Next, Jama or similar. 
 Experience supporting Verification & Validation, integration or testing activities. 
 Ability to interpret technical specifications and translate them into testable requirements. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement, communication and problem-solving skills. 
 Australian Citizenship 
 
   
  Desirable  
   
 
 Defence industry experience. 
 Experience across the full systems engineering lifecycle. 
 Exposure to Systems Engineering standards and V-Model methodologies. 
 Experience preparing test plans, verification procedures and validation reports. 
 Knowledge of system integration and acceptance testing. 
 Eligibility to obtain and maintain an Australian Defence Security Clearance. 
 
   What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to work on a significant and complex Defence capability program. 
 Brisbane-based role with flexible work arrangements. 
 Attractive contract rates and long-term project stability. 
 Exposure to advanced technologies and large-scale systems integration activities. 
 Collaborative engineering environment with experienced industry professionals. 
 Potential for contract extension and ongoing project involvement. 
 
 If you're a Systems Engineer or V&V Engineer looking to contribute to a major Defence program and enjoy working across requirements, integration, testing and system delivery, we'd love to hear from you. 
 Apply now to ali.kavanagh@hays.com.au  Please  click here  to apply.
